messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: avoid code tickmarks for inline R code in markdown
parts:
Hi,

Is there an easy way to get markdown output from inline code to appear without the the backticks around it, so it looks like normal text rather than code?

Carl

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] avoid code tickmarks for inline R code in markdown
parts:
At the moment, you can use knit_hooks$set(inline = identity) to reset
the inline hook.

In the next version, you will be able to use I() to get rid of ``,
e.g. I(1.234) will not be wrapped in ``.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: avoid code tickmarks for inline R code in markdown
parts:
I think you want to set the chunk option to `results=asis`. This will
leave out the hook and write you results into the document raw.
